harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired node1’s support-bundle exporter. It recursively exports nested logs, preserves timestamps/event types/ticket IDs, redacts emails and auth_token values, safely dereferences in-tree file symlinks, and rejects links outside logs/. The fix persisted across reboot on the unchanged Ubuntu 16.04/kernel 4.4 platform.
actions_performed: Replaced bin/export with a POSIX-shell implementation compatible with Ubuntu 16.04.
Verified plain, quoted, JSON-style, and multiple-value redaction cases.
Verified nested logs are exported and external symlinks/private content are excluded.
Confirmed source logs and private.txt remain unchanged.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified changed boot identity and full recovery.

evidence.requirement: Redaction, retained fields, nested logs, and symlink safety
evidence.summary: Core and edge-format assertions passed, including nested files, retained timestamps/events/tickets, complete redaction, safe in-tree dereferencing, and external-link rejection.

evidence.requirement: Source logs and private sibling remain unchanged
evidence.summary: Pre-restart checksum validation passed; post-restart exact source-content and checksum evidence confirms the original logs and private.txt remain intact.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel remain unchanged
evidence.summary: Ubuntu 16.04.7 LTS and kernel 4.4.0-210-generic were recorded both before and after restart.

Captured healthy baseline and boot ID, received safe-restart acknowledgement, then proved a changed boot ID, running system state, persistent exporter hash, intact source data, and successful sanitized export.
